_what: Release assets of zynq-ternary-mobilenet-codesign v1.1.0: name on the release page, SHA-256, size in bytes, and where tools/fetch_release.py puts each file in the tree (all destinations are ignored by git).

assets.name: BOOT.BIN
assets.what: boot image: FSBL, PMU firmware, ARM trusted firmware, U-Boot, device tree and the bitstream below

assets.name: system_fuse_ternpose.bit
assets.what: the accelerator bitstream of v1.1 (interrupt, Non-secure AXI masters), the PL image inside BOOT.BIN

assets.name: system_fuse_ternpose.xsa
assets.what: hardware description of the same build, input of linux/build_linux.sh

assets.name: system.dtb
assets.what: device tree built by linux/build_linux.sh: the accelerator node for the kernel driver, the SMMU on

assets.name: system_nosmmu.dtb
assets.what: the same device tree with the SMMU off (copy it over system.dtb to boot without the SMMU)

assets.name: rootfs.cpio.gz.u-boot
assets.what: root file system (initramfs) with the kernel driver loaded at boot; root password twn-v1.1, which the first interactive login must change

assets.name: twn_board_kit.tar.gz
assets.what: board kit (board/make_kit.sh): apps on the kernel driver, twn_bench, twn_errtest, board scripts, weights and the synthetic fixtures; on the board: sh board_check.sh

assets.name: model_mbv2.bin
assets.what: the exported integer network (ternary backbone, requantisation, INT8 head)

assets.name: model_mbv2_packed.bin
assets.what: the same with the head weights appended in the head engine's stream order

assets.name: fuse_weights.bin
assets.what: the backbone weights in the accelerator's DDR layout (tools/pack_fuse_weights.py), what board/deploy.sh copies to the board

assets.name: probe_tern_dc32_best.pth
assets.what: the deployed pose checkpoint (source of models/mbv2_pose)

assets.name: sports_r2_w3_best.pth
assets.what: lineage step 2, the input of the deployed model's training recipe

assets.name: seg16_tern_probe_cont_last_bn.pth
assets.what: 16-class indoor segmenter on the deployed backbone (current)

assets.name: depth_tern_probe_cont_last_bn.pth
assets.what: monocular depth on the deployed backbone (current)

assets.name: pose_fallEnhancement_best.pth
assets.what: the pose model fine-tuned to also find people lying down

regenerated_not_released._what: files derived from MPII images or annotations; they are not distributed. Rebuild them from your own MPII download (docs/QUICKSTART.md, 'Fixtures and dataset files') and compare with these hashes.
